column1: # The ordinary shapes every asset library starts with (geom/shape.rs).
# One row per shape; the name is the file it is written to (<name>.usda).
# form: how it is made - box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, plane, capsule,
# size: metres - edge (box, plane, pyramid base), diameter (sphere, cylinder,
#   cone, capsule), outer diameter (torus), circumscribed diameter (the
# height: metres - cylinder, cone, capsule (end to end), pyramid; torus: tube diameter.
# segment: steps around; ring: steps along (sphere, capsule, torus tube) or
#   steps in a rounded edge (box).  bevel: rounded-edge radius, metres.
# pip: pip radius, metres; pip_depth: a pip disc's thickness (half below the
#   face, half above it, so it shows as a shallow disc); spread: a pip
#   corner's offset from the face centre (layouts in pip.tsv).
# part / colour / roughness / metallic: one entry per part, space-separated;
#   colour is r g b (0-1, linear) per part.  - means not used.
